shows.title: Nemesis & Pole Shift / End-of-Life Care
shows.first_half: First Half: Author Marshall Masters will discuss pole-shift preparedness and his latest survival articles, including his theory that Nemesis, a brown dwarf companion to our Sun, could trigger a catastrophic pole shift around 2030. He’ll explain the celestial scenario he envisions and how people can prepare.
shows.second_half: Second Half: End-of-life care expert Brad Stuart, MD, will explore the difference between curing illness and finding healing when a cure is no longer possible. He’ll discuss how spirituality and human connection can bring comfort and peace at the end of life, offering guidance for patients and their loved ones.

shows.title: Ghost Communication / Ancient Irish Mysteries
shows.first_half: First Half: Ghost behaviorist Chris Bores will explore spirit behavior and share remarkable encounters from his attempts to communicate with the dead. He’ll introduce the BMC, his experimental communication device, and discuss demonic cleansing, spirit healing, and new theories he believes could expand paranormal research.
shows.second_half: Second Half: Researcher Doug Elwell will delve into the mysteries of ancient Ireland, from the peoples who settled the Emerald Isle to the giants, wizards, and monsters of its mythology. He’ll journey through Ireland’s four ancient provinces, exploring the legends, sacred sites that have shaped Irish culture.

shows.title: Legacy of the Beatles / Open Lines
shows.first_half: Today marks what would have been the 86th birthday of Beatles co-founder John Lennon. Author and historian Chuck Gunderson joins guest host Connie Willis (info) to explore the Beatles' lasting impact on music, culture, and society, tracing their rise from their early years through their 1970 breakup. He’ll revisit their explosive touring years and examine how stepping away from the road opened new creative possibilities in the studio, leading to some of their most enduring music. Followed by Open Lines in the latter half. Give Connie a call and discuss whatever is on your mind!
